lines.en: I walk into the village, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 长袍扫过草地，草就枯了。
lines.en: My robe sweeps the grass and it withers.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很慢，但没人敢挡。
lines.en: My steps are slow, and no one dares block them.

lines.zh: 绕坛三匝，我的影子叠起来。
lines.en: Three rounds of the altar stack my shadow.
My staff tip taps the ground once.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，火把会暗。
lines.en: Torches dim where I have passed.
I am in no hurry; souls come to me.
I stop and listen to the wind.
Ash falls from my sleeve.
I am waiting for it to clear my path.
The book in my hand turns its own pages.

lines.zh: 我念得很轻，只有死者听见。
lines.en: I chant softly; only the dead hear.

lines.zh: 我在数这座村子有多少魂。
lines.en: I am counting the souls in this village.
The runes on my staff pulse.
I cast two shadows.

lines.zh: 一只小鬼在我脚边磨牙。
lines.en: An imp grinds its teeth at my feet.

lines.zh: 书页上写着你的名字吗？
lines.en: Is your name written on this page?
I wait for the sky to darken further.

lines.zh: 我的手指在空气里画符。
lines.en: My fingers trace sigils in the air.
Souls smell like old iron.

lines.zh: 我咳嗽一声，地下有人应。
lines.en: I cough once, and something below answers.

lines.zh: 那些魂围着我转，很安静。
lines.en: The souls circle me quietly.
I flick a mote of ash away.
I am deciding whom to take first.

lines.zh: 指甲缝里的墨干了，我搓了搓。
lines.en: The ink under my nails has dried. I rub it away.

lines.zh: 灯灭了，我便把书举高些。
lines.en: The lamp died, so I hold the book a little higher.
I raise my eyes and you freeze.
You carry a soul, and it is bright.

lines.zh: 我见你身后跟着两个影子。
lines.en: I see two shadows trailing behind you.
I can pronounce your name.

lines.zh: 别低头，我想看清你的脸。
lines.en: Do not bow; I want your face.

lines.zh: 我举起杖，只是为了看清。
lines.en: I raise my staff only to see you clearly.
You are trembling; I can see it.
There is fire in your eyes. Good.

lines.zh: 你站哪，我拿杖尖点了印。
lines.en: My staff tip marks the spot where you stand.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着三十个魂。
lines.en: Thirty souls stand between us.
You look at my book; it looks back.
You stand steadier than the last one.

lines.zh: 这具身体，早就不算我的了。
lines.en: This body stopped being mine long ago.
The blood running down is black.
You cut my chant off halfway.
I feel pain; the book does not.
I steady myself on the staff.
These souls are shielding me.
A corner of my robe is torn.
I wrote this debt into the book.
I raise a hand and the wound closes.
Pain only makes my chant faster.
I eat nothing; I collect souls.

lines.zh: 你把魂递过来，我会收下。
lines.en: Offer me your soul and I will accept.
The pact is written; only a signature is missing.
The page stirs; it is waiting for you.
Do not fear, it is only a small memory.
What I pay outlasts a life.
Your shadow has already nodded.
I never take by force; I only wait.
One drop of blood writes one line.

lines.zh: 你犹豫时，我就多等一会。
lines.en: While you hesitate, I wait a little longer.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的袍角，像撞雾。
lines.en: You hit my robe like hitting fog.
I lift a hand and you fall back.
My staff comes across and blocks the way.
Do not touch the book; it knows hands.

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过去，我让了。
lines.en: You squeeze past me, and I allow it.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的魂晃了一下。
lines.en: That bump made your soul flicker.
I stand two heads above you.
My sleeve is heavier than iron.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，你赶紧过去。
lines.en: I yield half a step so you can pass.
All who bump me end up kneeling.
My companions all live in the book.

lines.zh: 我曾经也有过一个同门。
lines.en: I once had a fellow student.

lines.zh: 她走后，我就开始收集魂。
lines.en: After she left, I began collecting souls.
Page seven holds her handwriting.

lines.zh: 我们曾一起画同一个符。
lines.en: We once drew the same sigil together.

lines.zh: 我留着她的杖头，一直没换。
lines.en: I kept her staff head and never replaced it.
Now these souls keep me company.
We agreed whoever dies first waits.
I will not look for a second.

lines.zh: 夜里我念她的名字，很轻。
lines.en: At night I say her name, softly.
The book closes itself and keeps it.

lines.zh: 我拾起那截断骨，看了看。
lines.en: I pick up that broken bone and study it.
A dropped soul; I gather it in passing.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指，有旧主人的味。
lines.en: This ring smells of its old owner.

lines.zh: 碎片顺着袖子滑进书里。
lines.en: The shard slides down my sleeve into the book.

lines.zh: 捡东西这动作，我做过千次。
lines.en: I have picked things up a thousand times.
The book only keeps what it wants.
Whatever I pick up belongs to the book.
A broken arrow is useless, yet I keep it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，魂群跟着低下去。
lines.en: When I bend, the souls dip with me.
You stepped inside my circle.

lines.zh: 书页停了，停在你那一页。
lines.en: The pages stop at yours.

lines.zh: 杖尖停在你心口前一寸。
lines.en: My staff stops an inch from your heart.

lines.zh: 从这一刻，你是我的客人。
lines.en: From this moment you are my guest.
I have waited three nights for this.
The thread of souls is tied.
The door behind you closed itself.
Do not run; running leads into the book.
I begin the first line of the chant.
Every soul here turns to look at you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，地下有东西醒了。
lines.en: I raise my hand and something below wakes.
Your shadow kneels first.
I tap my staff tip three times.
Good. You will do, so hold still.

lines.zh: 你进门时，风铃响错了音。
lines.en: When you came in, the wind chime rang the wrong note.

lines.zh: 我合上书，这一页不用读了。
lines.en: I close the book. This page needs no reading.

lines.zh: 站在那儿，让我先量你的魂。
lines.en: Stand there. Let me measure your soul first.

lines.zh: 你已经在我名单的第一行了。
lines.en: You are already the first line of my list.
I follow you down the whole street.
The soul laser is already gathering.
My imps go first.
You hide indoors; I remove the wall.

lines.zh: 手掌从地下伸出来找你。
lines.en: A hand rises from the ground for you.
I walk and chant at the same time.
Your soul moves; I move with it.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路写进书里。
lines.en: I write your escape route into the book.

lines.zh: 你每喘一口，我就近一点。
lines.en: Each breath of yours brings me closer.
These souls are counting your steps.

lines.zh: 我不需要看见你，我感觉得到。
lines.en: I need not see you; I feel you.
Light chases out from my staff tip.
The faster you run, the faster the pages turn.

lines.zh: 我停在这里，是因为你快到了。
lines.en: I stop here because you are almost there.

lines.zh: 你往左跑，我先去左边等。
lines.en: You run left; I go left ahead of you and wait.

lines.zh: 门板自己合上，你听见了吗？
lines.en: The door shut on its own. Did you hear it?

lines.zh: 我的杖一路敲地，替你打拍子。
lines.en: My staff taps the ground, keeping time for you.

lines.zh: 你在井边转了两次，我都看着。
lines.en: You circled the well twice. I watched both times.

lines.zh: 灵魂先于你，跑到了前面。
lines.en: The souls ran ahead of you and got there first.

lines.zh: 你越慌，我的咒念得越顺。
lines.en: The more you panic, the smoother my chant runs.
My staff head falls with a crack of bone.
I press one hand to your forehead.
This blow takes one breath from you.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划过你的护甲。
lines.en: My nails rake across your armor.

lines.zh: 近身是我最不喜欢的距离。
lines.en: Close range is my least favorite distance.
I raise my arm; my sleeve is all bone.
You are knocked back, but your soul stays.
That strike used two tenths of my strength.
I seize your wrist, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 杖尾一扫，你脚下的地塌了。
lines.en: My staff sweeps and the ground gives way.

lines.zh: 我捏着你的魂，像捏一枚果。
lines.en: I hold your soul like a piece of fruit.
It hurts? Remember the feeling.
I do not shout; I simply strike.
After the blow I plant my staff again.

lines.zh: 祭坛亮了，我从光里站起来。
lines.en: The altar lit, and I rose out of the light.
The book landed first; then I appeared.

lines.zh: 三十年没人念那段咒了。
lines.en: No one has spoken that curse in thirty years.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，村里的狗都不叫了。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and the village dogs went quiet.

lines.zh: 我的长袍上还挂着旧灰。
lines.en: Old ash still clings to my robe.

lines.zh: 第一个看见我的人，跑得很快。
lines.en: The first to see me ran very fast.

lines.zh: 我数了数，这里有四十七个魂。
lines.en: I counted forty-seven souls here.
The staff in my hand feels like home.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，地下有回应。
lines.en: I called out, and something below answered.
A thin seam opened in the sky.

lines.zh: 我落地时，草都朝着我倒。
lines.en: When I landed, the grass leaned toward me.

lines.zh: 这本书认得我，我也认得它。
lines.en: The book knows me, and I know it.
I have not decided whom to start with.

lines.zh: 我的影子先铺满了院子。
lines.en: My shadow filled the yard before I did.

lines.zh: 烛芯自己燃了，我就势坐起。
lines.en: The wick lit itself. I sat up from there.

lines.zh: 我从书页的缝里爬出来，沾了灰。
lines.en: I crawl out between the pages, streaked with dust.

lines.zh: 这一夜很薄，一捅就破了。
lines.en: The night is thin. One poke and it tears.

lines.zh: 有人把祭坛摆歪了，我替他扶正。
lines.en: Someone set the altar askew. I straighten it for them.

lines.zh: 地下的东西先醒，我才睁开眼。
lines.en: Things below wake first, then I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我打了一个喷嚏，烛火全歪了。
lines.en: I sneeze once and every candle flame leans.
Fire burns slowly on me.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，骨头响了一串。
lines.en: I fall and my bones rattle in a row.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的袍子，我变重了。
lines.en: Water fills my robe and I grow heavy.
The blast scatters my swarm of souls.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我肩上，我拔了。
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 你的法术想读我的名字。
lines.en: Your spell is trying to read my name.
What hungers in me is not my stomach.

lines.zh: 雷落在我杖上，被它吃了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my staff and it drank it.

lines.zh: 虚空里也有魂，只是更冷。
lines.en: There are souls in the void, only colder.
